Numbering styles

Style 1) (list-style-type: paren-right)

  1. Read the brief.
  2. Visit the site and note any constraints that are not on the survey drawings, for example trees, overhead lines and shared access.
  3. Prepare the outline design.
  4. Present the outline design to the client.
